bc_perimenopause.definition: The transition before menopause, when the cycles often change.
bc_perimenopause.example: She was in perimenopause, and her cycles had changed for a while.

msa_age_range.definition: A span with a lower and an upper bound, used here for the ages a person will consider.
msa_age_range.example: Write your age range as two numbers, not as a feeling.

retina.definition: The screen at the back of your eye. Light lands on it and the picture begins.
retina.example: The picture forms on the retina.

roots.definition: The part under the soil. It holds the plant in place and drinks up water and minerals.
roots.example: The roots reached the water at the bottom of the pot.

turnaround_time.definition: How long a reply is expected to take. Often agreed in advance rather than assumed.
turnaround_time.example: Our usual turnaround time for quotations is two working days.
